brief:
Israeli forces killed four Palestinians and wounded several others in an operation in northern Gaza, according to a medical source cited by Al Jazeera. The shooting marked the latest deadly incident in the enclave amid ongoing conflict. Details about the circumstances of the killings remained limited.

In a separate development, Israeli forces detained 15 Palestinians during operations in the West Bank. The detentions added to a broader pattern of arrest campaigns across the occupied territory in recent weeks. No immediate details were provided about the identities or locations of those arrested.

title: Israeli forces kill four Palestinians in north Gaza
